method: agent pixel-read of every PNG in generations/round-001 (per art/adrs/ADR-0002)
context: Production round for the canon scene master, regenerated per user amendment: style-aligned to the picked character (r3-fullbody-flat-matte as style reference), water feature redefined as rock formation + koi pool fed by a bubbling/overflowing bubbler, with a meandering stream beside the pathway. Acceptance criteria in spec.json.

style_alignment_check.outline_match: PASS — warm brown outlines, same weight family as the character reference
style_alignment_check.palette_match: PASS — dusty pink + muted moss + cream family continuous with the character
style_alignment_check.matte_fills: PASS — flat matte, no photoreal texture, no bloom
style_alignment_check.character_absent: PASS — no animals/people/text (koi are requested content)

notes: All water-feature content present: stacked rock formation overflowing into a round koi pool (two tiny koi + ripple rings), stream meandering out of the pool with stepping stones.
Composition maps cleanly to the stage: left half is a wide quiet lawn (rabbit rest space), lantern mid-left, water feature right-of-center — instant-read hierarchy.
Cherry branches frame top corners with drifting petals; cream sky proportion is healthy for a cover crop.
Nits: waterfall reads as a sheet-and-moss stack more than a bubbling bubbler (overflow intent satisfied); koi count 2 vs brief's 'two or three' — within range.
Strong meander emphasis: stream winds with in-stream stepping stones, pool sits right-of-center with 4 tiny koi and ripple rings, waterfall overflow present.
Composition cost: cream sky occupies ~45% of the canvas — bottom-heavy; on wide-viewport cover crops it survives, but the empty sky wastes the frame and the garden band feels compressed.
Lantern mid-garden is slightly isolated; petal drift is sparse.

round_summary: Both candidates match the character style (the core amendment goal) and deliver the redesigned water content. Variant A is the master pick to propose; B documents the meander-heavy alternate. User pick gates promotion to assets/scene/.
